verdicts.reason: Both are nearly identical and broken the same way. The photo is cropped so far in that the eyes are gone and only a grinning mouth is left. The lightbulb, question-mark and atom doodles are piled on the face (the question mark sits on the teeth). The 'PODCAST WITH HARRY LEE HOFFMAN' line is tiny at banner size, and the left third is a cluttered mess while the molecule floats alone on the right. B's headline is slightly larger, with a little more room between it and the face/atom, so its hierarchy is marginally better than A's.
